To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a motif containing four hydroxyls in an acidic environment in the third cytosolic loop of the oposum alpha-2C AR is required for down-regulation.
the EESSTSES motif in the third intracellular domain of the oposson alpha-2C-adrenergic receptor is important in down-regulation of this receptor.
the alpha-2 adrenoceptor is down-regulated by phosphorylation of the third cytoplamic loop by G-protein coupled receptor kinases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the down-regulation mechanisms of the alpha-1 and alpha-2 adrenoceptor subtypes.
the mechanisms by which alpha(2)-adrenergic receptors (alpha(2)-ARs) are down-regulated.
the mechanisms by which alpha-adrenergic receptors down-regulate.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a motif with a serine/theronine sequence in the acidic environment of the third cytoplamic loop is important in alpha-2 adrenoreceptor down regulation and that this motif is phosphorylated by a protein kinase.
the opossumm alpha-2CAR down-regulates and the human alpha-1CAR down-regulated, but not the human alpha- 2CAR.
the acidic serine-rich motifs in the third cytosolic loop of the human alpha-1 and alpha-2 adrenoreceptors are involved in the down regulation of these receptors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a motif with at least three hydroxyl amino acids in an acidic environment in an appropriate location in a G protein-coupling receptor is required for receptor down-regulation.
the alpha-2 adrenoceptors, like the beta-1, beta-2 and beta-3 adrenoceptors, are down-regulated in a G-protein-coupled receptor (GRK) dependent manner.
the oposum alpha-2CAR downregulates and the human alpha- 2CAR does not down regulate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the oposum receptor has four serine residues in the third cytosolic loop of the receptor that are required for down-regulation.
the oposum alpha-2CAR down regulates in a manner that is different from the human alpha- 2C adrenerigc receptor.
the acidic serine-rich sequence in the third cytosolic loop of the alpha-1 adrenergic and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors is important for receptor down-regulation.
